title:
This Type is only for creating the name space within which users can discover
a host of functionality for authoring pipelines, processing features, and
deploying models, all in the context of the various {@link MlProject}s supported
in the C3 AI Reliability application.

The purpose of this module is to allow users to generate machine learning models, named {@link ReliabilityMlModel}s,
that utilize {@link ReliabilityAsset} data and defined constraints to monitor the health and functionality
of the asset.
name: ReliabilityMl
